name: ocr_recognize
description: Extract text from images or PDFs using OCR. Supports multiple providers: VLM-OCR models (via LLM connectors) and traditional OCR APIs (PaddleOCR, Baidu, Google, Azure). Returns plain text by default; use output_format for JSON (with coordinates) or Markdown.

source.description: Image or PDF to recognize. Accepts file path, URL, workspace:// URI, or attach:// URI.

provider.description: OCR provider to use. Can be an LLM connector ID (for VLM-OCR) or API preset key (paddleocr, baidu, google, azure). If omitted, uses the configured default from Settings.

output_format.description: Output format. 'text': plain extracted text (default). 'json': structured output with text blocks, coordinates, and confidence. 'markdown': formatted Markdown preserving document structure.

mode.description: Recognition mode. 'accurate': highest quality (default). 'standard': faster, lower resource usage.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language hint (e.g. 'zh', 'en', 'ja'). Helps improve accuracy for the specified language. Auto-detected if omitted.

type.description: Document category for specialized recognition. If a provider does not support the requested type, it degrades to 'general' with a metadata annotation.

pages.description: PDF page range, e.g. '1-5' or '1,3,7'. Applies only to PDF input.

prompt.description: Custom prompt for VLM-OCR models. Appended to the system prompt to guide extraction. Ignored by traditional OCR APIs.

extra.description: Additional provider-specific parameters as a JSON object. Passed directly to the provider API.
